cards.title: Urinary Excretion and Renal Clearance Data Structure
cards.claim: Renal clearance prediction requires urine collection intervals with start/end times relative to dosing, completeness status, volume, and analyte concentration. Interval vs. cumulative quantity must be preserved. Unchanged drug vs. metabolites must be distinguished. A missing interval is not a zero-amount collection.
conditions: Applicable when urinary excretion or renal/nonrenal split is requested.
Reuse qualified plasma exposure definitions with matched total/free basis, units, and analysis window for the intended translation comparison.
Calculation belongs to the later analysis module; this stage assesses data requirements.
required_inputs: Urine volume and analyte concentration (or reported amount excreted).
limitations: Pooled cage data cannot be treated as individual animal trajectories.
Missing data is not zero; it is a gap.
Published same-drug fe/CLR may be used as literature-reported inputs if permissions allow, but are not independently validated.
cards.downstream_use: Supports renal clearance component of total clearance prediction.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
